goal: Produce concise beginner-friendly summaries while minimizing technical error through source discipline, small batches, and independent verification of every summary.
eligibility: The coordinator must assign an exact, immutable, disjoint paper-ID list.
Only CORE_SYSTEMS and SYSTEMS_ADJACENT papers with metadata.json and relevance.json at READY_FOR_REVIEW may be summarized.
Do not summarize EXCLUDED or NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW papers.
Do not summarize incoming 2026 papers until their collector handoff is frozen and separately assigned.
required_reading: system overview or central design section
evaluation overview and the exact sections, figures, or tables supporting reported results

brief_output_contract.background: One or two short sentences containing only context needed to understand the paper.
brief_output_contract.villain: One sentence stating the concrete bottleneck, failure mode, or missing capability.
brief_output_contract.approach: Two or three sentences explaining the actual central mechanism and material assumptions.
brief_output_contract.impact: One sentence, phrased as the authors' claimed consequence rather than independently proven fact.
brief_output_contract.evaluation: At most three short sentences plus no more than two important quantitative results.
brief_output_contract.limitations: One or two source-supported limitations or assumptions; use null when the paper does not support a concise statement.
brief_output_contract.phd_group_signal: One sentence about methodology or artifact style, never advisor quality.

technical_accuracy_rules: Use the official paper PDF as the primary summary source; metadata, abstracts, snippets, and secondary summaries are insufficient.
Describe the mechanism at the same scope as the paper. Do not broaden a result from one workload, platform, threat model, or deployment setting into a universal claim.
Preserve material trust assumptions, hardware requirements, workload constraints, failure assumptions, and excluded cases.
Every number must exactly match the paper and include a source ID plus a page, section, figure, or table locator.
Prefer one or two representative results over many numbers.
Name baselines accurately and distinguish simulation, prototype, trace replay, formal proof, measurement, and production deployment.
Do not infer causality, production readiness, generality, state of the art, or real-world deployment unless the paper explicitly supports it.
Do not invent limitations. If evidence is ambiguous, omit the claim, set the relevant field to null when allowed, and record the uncertainty.
Clearly attribute scientific results to the authors.
Copying or lightly paraphrasing an abstract does not satisfy the task.
writer_workflow: A new writer receives at most five calibration papers.
After its calibration batch passes independent review, the coordinator may assign batches of at most 25 papers.
Each writer uses a unique agent ID and claim file and edits only assigned summary.json files.
A writer sets summary workflow to READY_FOR_REVIEW and leaves verification.verified_by null.
A writer does not begin another batch until the current batch is handed off and validation passes.
independent_review_gate: Every summary receives independent source-based review; sampling is insufficient for summary accuracy.
The reviewer reopens the official PDF and verifies the problem, mechanism, assumptions, evaluation setting, baselines, every number and locator, limitations, and claimed impact.
Any technical misstatement, unsupported generalization, wrong number, wrong baseline, or omitted material assumption produces an ERROR and CHANGES_REQUESTED.
The writer fixes only summary.json; the independent reviewer then reopens the source and verifies the correction.
No summary is eligible for release or UI publication until the independent review is APPROVED with no open ERROR.
batch_integrity: Writer paper-ID lists must be pairwise disjoint.
Reviewer paper-ID lists must be pairwise disjoint.
A reviewer cannot review a summary it authored.
Incoming collector edits or relevance changes do not automatically enter an existing summary assignment.
